dogecoin.text: Solana (SOL) has broken out of the 50-day SMA. Dogecoin (DOGE) rose above the SMA ($0.38) on Jan. 4. The bears tried to pull the price back below the 50 days, but the bulls held their ground.
Dogecoin's price surged 21% over the past week, peaking at $0.39. Shiba Inu, Pepe and Bonk were up 7%, 10% and 14%. The rally follows renewed interest from whales.
